user.title: Connect to PLOC
user.description: Enter your PLOC account credentials and the PLOUD server URL to use. The suggested default URL can be changed.

reconfigure.title: Change PLOUD server
reconfigure.description: Change the base URL used to connect to PLOUD. The currently configured URL is prefilled. The device identifier and token will be kept.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with PLOC
reauth_confirm.description: The PLOUD connection must be renewed. Enter your PLOC account credentials to sign in again and reactivate PLOUD.

error.invalid_auth: PLOC authentication or PLOUD activation failed. Check the Home Assistant log for the failing stage and technical details.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the PLOC service. Check the Internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_server: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS base URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.

init.title: Synchronization settings
init.description: Choose how often the cellar is synchronized and the language requested from PLOUD.

get_inventory.name: Get inventory
get_inventory.description: Return the stocked wines and their rack positions without creating entities.

search.name: Search
search.description: Match wine name, appellation, region, country, grape or cuvée.

config_entry_id.name: Ploc Cellar configuration
config_entry_id.description: Select the PLOUD connection to use.

sync.name: Synchronize
sync.description: Trigger an immediate read-only synchronization with PLOUD.
